title: fluorojip: Analysis of Chlorophyll a Fluorescence Transient Parameters (version 0.2.0)
description: R package for transparent extraction, calculation, and validation of chlorophyll a fluorescence OJIP (JIP-test) parameters. This archive contains the package source of the release described in the Royal Society Open Science article, the bundled reference files (inst/extdata), the validation script (validation/run_validation.R), and the test suite.
